title: MZ Teamartrrix Shop Themes Always crashes

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body: Hi, I did recently buy the Team Artrix shop themes plugin bundle on Itch.io with the intention of using them in my game. I thought I added each file to the correct folder, but each time I enter the shop in game, I get the following error message, which I have no idea what it means. Do anyone else know what is wrong? How can I get it to work?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
"is not a function" in this context can have only three possible causes:
1) you continued a now incompatible savefile instead of starting a new playtest (as required in most such cases)
2) you're missing a prerequisite plugin or your plugins are ordered wrong
3) the plugin contains bugs and is not yet stable - you might want to give a link to the itch.io site for us to compare

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
this you follow those steps
Code:
Use PLUGIN COMMAND (Set Shop Theme to "Armory") before opening a shop to display the "Armory" theme. Use PLUGIN COMMAND (Clear Shop Theme) to go  back to RPG Maker MZ default shop theme
Not all shop-related windows added by OTHER PLUGINS will be shown in the "Armory" theme!
This theme LOOKS BEST in 1280 x 720 game resolution or larger... It will look fine in 816 x 624, but not at its most beautiful
The notetag <MenuImg: filename> can be put in an item, weapon, or armor's notes and you can replace the icon image with a graphic from img/pictures/ for this shop theme!
You can use multiple shop themes together in one project and switch between them using PLUGIN COMMANDS
However, if I read those, it asume to me, that some of the settings are hardcoded.
but I don't know if this is also in the helpfile of the plugin or if they are equal or not?
if they are, I highly suggest to reach out to the author and explain what you did
that cause the crash.
if paid plugin are obfuscated, its hard to debug or make modification to fit your needs.
Edit:
Also, there is a demo you can double check if you did everything correct.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
your descriptions of when the plugin works and when not means that the plugin itself has no bugs, but that you have an incompatibility with your current project.
which core version has that project?
did you delete anything in the database? (this is only important if the new projects database contains entries that had been deleted in the working project)

Yeah, I did delete pretty much all old skills and items from the base project when I started the current game, though some like potions were simply renamed. Though I did try copying over the items from the current project into the new one for test and those items works with the shop there, so I don't know. Though it might have something to do with the preset of the item icons, I don't know.
Edit. As for what core version, I don't know but I own MZ on Steam, you would think that would update automatically. All versions of projects  I tried this in has been in MZ. I guess we need to figure out exactly what is incompatible, because it does not seem to be another plugin.
Edit 2. Did try to upadte the game to version 1. 10. 0, still didn't work. Also copying over the plugins and settings from my project to the new project and deleted all base items and copied over all items from the project, still works. So it can't be the plugins or the items that cause the conflict.
Edit 3. Managed to narrow down the conflict to somewhere in the data folder. But I am not sure where yet.
Edit 4. Got it, something about the system.json file causes the plugin not to work, not sure what or how to fix it though.
Edit 5. Solved the problem. I think it was that some of the sound effects in system caused a conflict, while the default sound effects didn't. Weird, but I at least got it to work now.
